[![Open in Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/lukmanovr/dkr/blob/main/homeworks/hw03_frontiers.ipynb){target="_blank"}

**≈ 5–10 hours · individual work · 10% of the course grade**

One notebook, three parts, covering expressiveness, typed message passing,
scaling audits, and link prediction discipline:

- **Part A · Derivations (30 pts).** Four proofs in markdown cells: the
  $K_{3,3}$-vs-prism pair no GNN can separate (and the one-scalar feature
  that can); the R-GCN parameter audit on a skewed 58-relation schema; the
  3-layer SGC collapse and the task where the deleted nonlinearity was
  load-bearing; and the formal 0.5-AUC theorem for symmetric decoders on
  direction prediction.
- **Part B · Implementation (60 pts, autograded, fully deterministic).**
  Three modules you will reuse for the rest of your career: the capacity
  auditor (memory bill + fanout bound + fits/OOM verdicts, asserted on the
  lecture's arxiv and products numbers); the split validator that must catch
  four planted leaks by name; and the ranking-metrics module (pairwise AUC,
  Hits@K, MRR) that must reproduce the model-A/model-B metric disagreement.
- **Part C · Investigation (10 pts).** The negatives experiment: Adamic–Adar
  under uniform vs degree-matched negatives, with a report on what hardening
  costs and what that says about uniform-negative evaluations.

are released. Regrade window: one week after grades post.

## FAQ

**Part B says deterministic — does SMOKE matter?** No: Part B has no
training and no sampling beyond fixed seeds, so SMOKE and full runs agree
by construction. Run *Restart and run all* and submit.

**Can I hand-write Part A?** Yes — paste a *legible* photo into the
markdown cell.

**May I use an AI assistant?** Yes, with disclosure in the final cell, per
the honor code; you must be able to explain any line and any proof step in
person.

**Something is broken / ambiguous.** Post in the course forum thread for
HW3 — clarifications get pinned there.
